title: Tokyo temp anomaly z>1 leads TTF/HH ratio
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Tokyo temperature anomaly 20d z-score > 1 (cold/heat demand shock proxy) leads the TTF/Henry Hub ratio (+) at 1-5 days more than raw TTF returns [weather.tokyo.temp_anomaly -> finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub] (parent: R2-0038)
message: Not supported: Tokyo temp anomaly z>1 vs TTF/HH ratio r=-0.007 (n=387), best lag 7d r=-0.09; trade rule 25 trades, hit 0.52, excess -0.2%, war-test excess -2.9%; actionability 0.98

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.tokyo.temp_anomaly rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long ratio:ttf_henryhub next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 7 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Null control: Tokyo temperature anomaly 20d z-score > 1 does not lead TTF=F log returns (+) by 1-3 days either; if the ratio result was noise this should also fail [weather.tokyo.temp_anomaly -> finance.TTF=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0135)
